The `source` array references a legitimate Git repository associated with the project, and while it uses an unpinned mutable branch (default: master), this is typical for `-git` packages and does not affect the safety of sourcing the file. No suspicious or obfuscated code appears in the global scope.

All variable manipulations (e.g., `_pkg_name_ver=${_pkgname}`) are benign and consistent with standard PKGBUILD practices. There is no evidence of malicious execution triggered simply by sourcing the file.
</details>
